result:
Task 94 is shipped but not finished: the A-t4 and C-t4 re-measure has not run, so there are no new p50/p95 numbers.

- **Code:** I found the whole ladder already in the game from earlier runs, v34.13 to v34.16. It matches steps 1 to 6: it steers by frame gap plus work time, has the three new rungs and the 10-second timing rules, carries quality over to the next raid, and has the fixed resolution hint. I made no changes this run.
- **Re-measure:** `runA.sh`, `runC.sh` and the Chrome scripts are not on my allowed command list, so I couldn't run them. `notes/coord-07/94-ladder-after` still doesn't exist. I did not make up any numbers. The old ones are A-t4 p50 40.8 / p95 50.1 ms, and C-t4 player 1 148.5 / 187.1 and player 2 146.7 / 217.6.
- **Pictures:** I didn't take new ones. In the earlier round-3 rung 2 picture, the sparks are down and the world edges stay sharp. The critic gave both rung pictures 2, but its findings are about the whole HUD, not the ladder, and they would reverse his later orders. So I left those alone.

My notes are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/94-ladder-sheds-sooner.md`.

Watch line for his next play: a raid that turns softer or loses sparks while nothing is happening, or sparks or haze that come and go. The first 20 seconds of each raid should look like the rest.

TASK PARTIAL: the A-t4 / C-t4 re-measure still has to run from a lane that is allowed to run `runA.sh` and `runC.sh`, with the new p50/p95 written beside the old ones in `notes/coord-07/`.
